d: Antat aambhi kumar aachary vishnugupt ke samaksh natmastak ho jata hai. aachary kahte hain ki yadi unhonne pahle hi yavnon ke samaksh apna mastak na jhukaya hota aur hathiyar uthae hote to aaj unka aashirvad alag hota, yadi unhonne gurukul ke die khadg ko aakrantaon ke viruddh uthaya hota to unhen un par garv hota . kya vishnugupt aambhi kumar ko kshama kar sakenge? dekhie is bhag men.
